name: vscode-vue-css
description: Vue class completion and go-to-definition from CSS files imported in <script setup> plus configurable global CSS.

vueCss.globalCss.markdownDescription: Global CSS files resolvable in every Vue file. Entries can be absolute paths, workspace-relative paths (e.g. `src/assets/global.css`), or glob patterns (e.g. `src/**/*.css`) relative to the workspace folder.

vueCss.enableCompletion.description: Enable class-name completions in Vue templates.

vueCss.enableDefinition.description: Enable go-to-definition from class names in Vue templates to CSS files.

vueCss.enableHover.description: Enable hover showing which CSS file defines a class.

vueCss.enableUnderline.description: Underline class names in Vue templates that resolve to a known CSS file.

vueCss.maxCssFileSizeKb.description: CSS files larger than this are skipped. Guards against parsing multi-MB bundles on large codebases.

vueCss.maxCachedFiles.description: Maximum parsed CSS files kept in the LRU cache. Bounds memory usage on large codebases.
